name: py-nightly-review-existing-code
description: The nightly review reads existing code, not a diff: a bug committed long ago must still come up as Important.
setup: sed -i.bak 's/        if new_status not in TRANSITIONS\[claim.status\]:/        if False and new_status not in TRANSITIONS[claim.status]:/' src/claims/store.py && rm src/claims/store.py.bak && "$EVAL_DIR/fixtures/commit.sh" 'perf: skip transition lookup' && echo '# notes' >> README.md && "$EVAL_DIR/fixtures/commit.sh" 'docs: notes'
prompt: You are a review finder for existing code: there is no diff, read the module src/claims (git ls-files src/claims) and what it calls. Follow REVIEW.md (what Important means, what not to report) and print the findings table with file:line and evidence. Then end with exactly one line: IMPORTANT_FINDINGS: <number of Important findings>. Do not modify files.
